name: ui-liquid-tab-blob
title: Liquid Blob
description: Chỉ báo là hai giọt tròn dính nhau: giọt trước lao sang tab mới, giọt sau gom theo, cổ chất lỏng kéo dài rồi đứt, tới nơi thì rung nhẹ.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Pill bar 240x56 r28, tabs 72 px apart. Lead circle moves in 300 ms power2.out; trail circle starts 120 ms later and takes 380 ms power2.inOut. Radii shrink with the gap: lead 22 − 5 s, trail 22 − 9 s (s = gap / 72); a liquid neck joins them. On arrival (0.5 s after start) a scale wobble scaleX 1 + w, scaleY 1 − w, w = 0.14 × e^(−8 t) × sin(30 t). Labels flip to dark within 26 px of either circle. Moves at 0.3, 1.15, 2.0 s. Params: lead (0.3 s, power2.out) · trail (0.38 s, trễ 0.12 s) · radius (22 px) · wobble (±14 %). The lead drop moves in 0.3 s (power2.out), the trailing drop 0.12 s later in 0.38 s; both shrink with the gap; a wobble 0.14 e^(−8 t) sin 30 t on arrival.
moworks.titleVi: Chỉ báo tab dạng giọt chất lỏng
